newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU Boeing approval "a good measure"-De Silguy.
newsitem.headline: EU Boeing approval "a good measure"-De Silguy.

text.p: European approval of Boeing Co's merger with McDonnell Douglas would be a good thing, as it would avoid a dispute with the United States and pave the way for Airbus to do more business in the United States, the European Union economic affairs commissioner said on Wednesday.
"I think the authorisation measure is a good measure," Commissioner Yves-Thibault De Silguy told RTL radio.

"What would we Europeans have said, we French in particular, if U.S. authorities had imposed conditions or blocked a merger of a French company with a German company? We would have said, 'What business is it of yours?'"
EU sources have said the European Commission would formally approve the $15 billion Boeing-McDonnell Douglas merger after preliminary approval from an EU advisory committee last Friday.
"What Europe is doing here...it's setting conditions for Boeing with the aim of opening the market," De Silguy said.
"The decision to authorise the merger is best for Airbus which will have the U.S. market opened up to it as a consequence," he said.
Toulouse-based Airbus is a consortium made up of four European aerospace companies.
